messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for eu-west-az4 - serving errors > 8% (5xx) and token queue growth. PD: PD-INC-4521

jordan (oncall): acked. I'm on it — joining now.

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledged by jordan (oncall) — escalation timer 15m.

maria (sre): seeing backend pool `rw-infer-eu-west-az4` 5xx spike to 9.8% and p95 latency doubled. KV cache misses up ~3x.

tina (ops): 2 nodes showing NIC drops on C-socket, kernel logs full of `i40e` errors. Not sure if it's host NIC or fabric.

jordan (oncall): good catch. I'm rolling quick checks, running `kubectl get pods -n redwood-serving -o wide --selector=zone=eu-west-az4` and checking instance health in console.

maria (sre): paste:```
# suspicious pods
kubectl get pods -n redwood-serving -l zone=eu-west-az4 -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.status.phase} {.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount}\n{end}'
# shows 3 restarts in last 5m on shard-proxy-7f9d
```

alex (eng-lead): if NIC looks flaky we should prepare failover plan — prefer traffic-divert to eu-west-az2 (same region, different az) and enable degraded-mode caches. Notify customers on status page if we start divert.

jordan (oncall): agree. Step 1: attempt local mitigation (drain bad nodes, restart kube-proxy) Step 2: if errors don't drop <5% in 10m, activate routing fallback to eu-west-az2.

incident-bot: Runbook hint: see /runbooks/az-network-degrade.

maria (sre): running `systemd-analyze` on nodes shows repeated NIC resets. I'm going to cordon + drain the two hosts with resets to minimize error surface.

tina (ops): cordon/drain in progress on host-az4-12 and host-az4-14. ETA ~3m.

jordan (oncall): noted. Starting canary divert (20% traffic to eu-west-az2) using routing control plane:```
# routing command (internal)
redwoodctl routing set-divert --from eu-west-az4 --to eu-west-az2 --percent 20 --reason "az4 NIC instability"
```

pagerduty-bot: Escalation scheduled if not stable by +15m.

cs-notify-bot: Preparing a short customer-facing note: "We are investigating elevated errors affecting some requests in eu-west-az4. Partial traffic diversion underway. More updates in 15 minutes." Alex please review.

alex (eng-lead): LGTM — send. Also prepare incident bridge if we hit degrade threshold.

maria (sre): after draining those two hosts error rate dropped to 6.1% and queue depth is falling. p95 still ~1.9x baseline.

jordan (oncall): increasing divert to 50% to relieve load while we confirm NIC hardware. `redwoodctl ... --percent 50`

incident-bot: Audit: divert to eu-west-az2 50% (initiated by jordan).

maria (sre): good improvement — 5xx down to 3.2% now and cache miss rate stabilizing. Keep monitoring for 10m.

tina (ops): I've opened a ticket with cloud provider for NIC replacement on the two hosts (SR-98721). ETA for hardware swap 2 hours.

jordan (oncall): action items: 1) keep divert at 50% until provider confirms hardware replaced or we can reprofix; 2) schedule full failover if errors climb above 5% for >10m; 3) update status page in 10m.

alex (eng-lead): if stable for 30m we'll roll back divert and de-schedule escalation. If not stable, we'll prepare full failover to eu-west (region) using spare capacity in az2/az3 and inform sales/CS.

cs-notify-bot: customer status posted: "Partial traffic diversion in place to mitigate elevated errors in eu-west-az4; customers may see occasional latency increases. We will update in 15 minutes."

pagerduty-bot: Reminder: please add pager note with commands run and hosts drained.

jordan (oncall): adding notes now. I'm staying on for handoff. If I need to step out I'll hand to alex.

maria (sre): monitoring graphs: cpu stable, errors trending down. KV cache rehydrates. Marking as watch — will update in 10m.

incident-bot: Thread status: Mitigation in progress (divert 50%). No customer-facing outage declared. Keep thread for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:

jordan (oncall): thanks team. I'll keep this thread updated and escalate if anything changes.
